PROCEDURE item_change (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then

 end if ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.access_class != :vuac_block.access_class or
 :global.user_id != :vuac_block.user_id then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C06C05',
 :vuac_block.user_id||','||
 :vuac_block.access_class||
 ',','D',chk); 
 end if;
IF :global.access_class = :vuac_block.access_class and
 :global.user_id = :vuac_block.user_id 
THEN
 null;
ELSE
 if :vuac_block.access_class is not null and
 :vuac_block.user_id is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_lab_user_access
 WHERE access_class = :vuac_block.access_class and
 user_id = :vuac_block.user_id ;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C06C05',
 :vuac_block.user_id||','||
 :vuac_block.access_class||
 ',','U',chk); 

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C06C05',
 :vuac_block.user_id||','||
 :vuac_block.access_class||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_insert_rg (v_rg_name in VARCHAR2, v_col_det in VARCHAR2,
 v_data_string in VARCHAR2, v_mode in
VARCHAR2,
 i_out out INTEGER)
 IS
 h_rg RECORDGROUP;
 h_col GROUPCOLUMN;
 i_row INTEGER;
 v_char_col VARCHAR2(40); /* record group data */
 n_num_col NUMBER(20,5); /* record group data */
 d_DATE_col DATE; /* record group data */
 v_char_data VARCHAR2(40); /* actual data */
 n_num_data NUMBER(20,5); /* actual data */
 d_date_data DATE; /* actual data */
 v_col_name VARCHAR2(40);
 i_j INTEGER := 0; /* for createing coumn name */
 i_i INTEGER := 0; /* variable for positioning of col_det in string
*/
 v_match VARCHAR2(2) := NULL;
 i_start INTEGER := 1;
 dup_record EXCEPTION;
 next_column EXCEPTION;
 error_exit EXCEPTION;
 chk_record EXCEPTION;
 del_record EXCEPTION;
 add_record EXCEPTION;
 no_record EXCEPTION;
BEGIN
 i_out := 0;
 h_rg := FIND_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 IF ID_NULL(h_rg) THEN
 RAISE error_exit;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'A'
 THEN
 RAISE add_record;
 END IF;
 i_row := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(h_rg);
 i_i := 1;
 FOR i_x IN 1..i_row
 LOOP
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 i_j := i_j + 1;
 v_col_name := 'COL_' || TO_CHAR(i_j);
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'C'
 THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 v_char_col := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(h_col, i_x);
 v_char_data :=
SUBSTR(v_data_string,i_start,(INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) -
i_start));
 IF v_char_col = v_char_data
 THEN
 v_match := 'OK';
 ELSE
 v_match := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'N'
 THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 n_num_col := GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(h_col, i_x);
 n_num_data :=
TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(v_data_string,i_start,(INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start)
- i_start)));
 IF n_num_col = n_num_data
 THEN
 v_match := 'OK';
 ELSE
 v_match := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'D'
 THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 d_date_col := GET_GROUP_DATE_CELL(h_col, i_x);
 d_date_data :=
TO_DATE(SUBSTR(v_data_string,i_start,(INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) -
i_start)),'MM/DD/YYYY');
 IF d_date_col = d_date_data
 THEN
 v_match := 'OK';
 ELSE
 v_match := NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF v_match = 'OK'
 THEN
 i_i := i_i + 3;
 IF i_i > NVL(length(v_col_det), 0)
 THEN
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'D'
 THEN
 i_i := i_x;
 RAISE del_record;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'U'
 THEN
 RAISE dup_record;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'C'
 THEN
 RAISE chk_record;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RAISE next_column;
 ELSE
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN next_column
 THEN
 i_start := INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) + 1;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 i_j := 0;
 i_i := 1;
 i_start := 1;
 END LOOP;
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'U'
 THEN
 RAISE add_record;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'D'
 THEN
 RAISE no_record;
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(v_mode) = 'C'
 THEN
 i_out := 0;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN add_record
 THEN
 i_row := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(h_rg);
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(h_rg,END_OF_GROUP);
 i_row := i_row + 1;
 i_j := 0;
 i_i := 1;
 i_start := 1;
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 i_j := i_j + 1;
 v_col_name := 'COL_' || TO_CHAR(i_j);
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'C'
 THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 v_char_data :=
SUBSTR(v_data_string,i_start,(INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) -
i_start));
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(h_col, i_row,v_char_data);
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'N'
 THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 n_num_data :=
TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(v_data_string,i_start,(INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start)
- i_start)));
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(h_col, i_row,n_num_data);
 END IF;
 IF UPPER(SUBSTR(v_col_det,i_i,1)) = 'D'
 THEN
 h_col := FIND_COLUMN(v_rg_name || '.' || v_col_name);
 d_date_data :=
TO_DATE(SUBSTR(v_data_string,i_start,(INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) -
i_start)),'MM/DD/YYYY');
 SET_GROUP_DATE_CELL(h_col, i_row,d_date_data);
 END IF;
 i_i := i_i + 3;
 IF i_i > NVL(LENGTH(v_col_det), 0)
 THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 i_start := INSTR(v_data_string,',',i_start) + 1;
 END;
 END LOOP;

 WHEN dup_record
 THEN
 i_out := i_row;
 WHEN del_record
 THEN
 DELETE_GROUP_ROW(h_rg,i_i);
 WHEN chk_record
 THEN
 i_out := 1;
 WHEN no_record
 THEN
 i_out := 1;
 WHEN error_exit
 THEN
 i_out := 99999;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE create_rg (v_rg_nme VARCHAR2, v_rmk VARCHAR2) IS
 h_rg RECORDGROUP;
 v_rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := v_rg_nme;
 h_gc GROUPCOLUMN;
 n_errcode NUMBER;
 n_i NUMBER;
 v_col_name VARCHAR2(6);
 i_j INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
 h_rg := FIND_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 
 IF ID_NULL(h_rg) THEN
 h_rg := CREATE_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 ELSE
 DELETE_GROUP(h_rg);
 h_rg := CREATE_GROUP(v_rg_name);
 END IF;
 
 n_i := 1;
 
 loop
 i_j := i_j + 1;
 v_col_name := 'COL_' || TO_CHAR(i_j);
 IF SUBSTR(v_rmk,n_i, 1) = 'C' THEN
 h_gc := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg,v_col_name, CHAR_COLUMN,
 to_NUMBER(substr(v_rmk, n_i + 1, 2)));
 END IF;
 
 IF SUBSTR(v_rmk,n_i, 1) = 'N' THEN
 h_gc := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg, v_col_name, NUMBER_COLUMN);
 END IF;
 
 IF SUBSTR(v_rmk,n_i,1) = 'D' THEN
 h_gc := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg, v_col_name, DATE_COLUMN);
 END IF;
 
 n_i := n_i + 3;
 
 IF n_i > NVL(LENGTH(v_rmk), 0) THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;

select code,code_desc from master_codes where code_type = 'ACLAS' 
and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, sysdate) BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, sysdate) + 365)
